🔬 陌生算子/字段释义

算子/字段含义

📝 计算步骤（一步一步解释）

  1. 计算 previous_close：close.shift(1)
  2. 计算 downside_tail：(previous_close - low).clip(lower=0.0) / previous_close
  3. 计算 upside_tail：(high - previous_close).clip(lower=0.0) / previous_close
  4. 计算 downside_energy：downside_tail.pow(2).ewm(span=30, adjust=False, min_periods=20).mean()
  5. 计算 upside_energy：upside_tail.pow(2).ewm(span=30, adjust=False, min_periods=20).mean()
  6. 计算 tail_asymmetry：downside_energy / (downside_energy + upside_energy)
  7. 计算 drawdown：1.0 - close / close.滚动窗口(60, min_periods=60).max()
⚠ 该因子原始 IC 为负，已整体取反（×(-1)）调正方向；下列步骤展示的是原始公式的计算过程。

🐍 原始 Python 代码 (factor_delivery)

"kw">class="kw">def factor_tail_fragility_ewm_drawdown(df): """Causally smoothed downside-tail share conditioned on trailing drawdown.""" df_copy = df.copy() previous_close = df_copy["close"].shift(1) downside_tail = (previous_close - df_copy["low"]).clip(lower=0.0) / previous_close.replace(0.0, np.nan) upside_tail = (df_copy["high"] - previous_close).clip(lower=0.0) / previous_close.replace(0.0, np.nan) downside_energy = downside_tail.pow(2).ewm(span=30, adjust="kw">class="kw">False, min_periods=20).mean() upside_energy = upside_tail.pow(2).ewm(span=30, adjust="kw">class="kw">False, min_periods=20).mean() tail_asymmetry = downside_energy / (downside_energy + upside_energy).replace(0.0, np.nan) drawdown = 1.0 - df_copy["close"] / df_copy["close"].rolling(60, min_periods=60).max().replace(0.0, np.nan) df_copy["factor_tail_fragility_ewm_drawdown"] = -tail_asymmetry * drawdown "kw">class="kw">return df_copy["factor_tail_fragility_ewm_drawdown"]
